content: POST {org}/{project}/_apis/wit/reporting/workitemrevisions: project-scoped (not team/iteration), body filter fields/types/includeLatestOnly, paged by continuationToken with isLastBatch; startDateTime bounds start. Replaying it for sprint baseline scans every revision in the project since the start date. WIQL ASOF plus GetWorkItems asOf gives point-in-time membership and fields in one query per team instead.
